bullets.text: Largest Flight Sim Update - Sim Update 5 for **Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024** introduces fully unlocked career modes.
Windows Insider Enhancements - New updates simplify navigation and control for **Windows Insiders**, enhancing user experience.
CVE-2026-31431 Vulnerability - A high-severity **Linux** privilege escalation flaw poses risks to cloud environments.
Microsoft Agent 365 Launch - **Agent 365** now available, enhancing governance and security for AI agents.
Email Threat Trends - **Microsoft** detected 8.3 billion phishing threats in Q1 2026, with QR code attacks rising.
Sovereign Private Cloud Scaling - **Azure Local** now supports thousands of nodes, enhancing local workload management.
Next Phase with OpenAI - **Microsoft** and **OpenAI** announce an amended agreement to enhance AI platform collaboration.
